summary: A Google DeepMind product lead announced that visible watermarks on Gemini-generated images are now optional, while invisible SynthID watermarking and C2PA metadata continue to be applied for provenance and can be checked via Gemini or Search.

practices.reason: Invisible SynthID/C2PA metadata provides a built-in way to check provenance of generated images, but this is a described product feature rather than a transferable measurement technique.
practices.quote: invisible SynthID watermarks and C2PA metadata are still being used for transparency. So you can still use Gemini or Search to see if an image was AI-generated.
